name: Tsukiyami no Majin
source:
Shiki with friends approaches enemy castle for the final battle with the demon. However, an ambush is prepared for them. Is happy end still possible in these circumstances?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
志贵与朋友们前往敌方城堡，准备与恶魔展开最终决战。然而，那里早已设下埋伏。在这种情况下，他们还可能迎来幸福结局吗？
